release_notes: Release v1.0.3 adds WebUI workspace navigation, themes, and agent management; fixes PyJWT security advisories; and improves frontend asset cache busting.

changes.note: Bumped application version to 1.0.3 and constrained PyJWT to a secure version.
Added v1.0.3 notes for the latest two commits and the PyJWT security fix.
Updated English and localized README release notes to v1.0.3.
Bumped the packaged update manifest to v1.0.3.
Updated the Windows desktop application version to 1.0.3.0.
Updated the WebUI package version to 1.0.3.
Updated the WebUI lockfile package version to 1.0.3.
Updated PyJWT to 2.14.0 to resolve known security advisories.
